requirements.text: The system must allow a member to send requests to other members regarding the delivery of a driver's smart card.
The system must support bulk requests for driver smart card holders.
The system must provide automatic replies to request senders via a standard interface.
The system must track the workflow between requests and their corresponding replies.
The system must automatically transmit alert messages when transaction delay constraints are not met.
The system must allow administrators to extract usage statistics, including reply delays and transaction success rates.
The system must provide management of user rights and permissions.
The system must support various message types including pre-delivery checks, lost/stolen cards, renewals, exchanges, and duplicates.
The system must allow the addition of new members to the network through administrative tasks.
The system must provide application-level security, including non-repudiation and encryption.
The system must prevent any member or administrator from reconstructing a consolidated European database from exchanged messages.
The system must allow Card Issuing Authorities to query and modify the status of driver and workshop cards.
The system must guarantee data privacy and non-repudiation for all transactions.
The system must respond to enforcement authority requests in less than 1 minute.
The system must support 24x7 availability.
The system must be robust, fault-tolerant, and capable of recovering from power cuts or disasters.
The system interface must be based on end-user concepts and be easy to learn.
The system must be maintainable, extensible, and capable of migrating to upgraded hardware or operating systems.
The system must use the network facilities provided by the TESTA-II network.
The system must support data encoding solutions for different character sets and name matching rules.
